description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_AlphaValue, which extends a numeric CSS attribute value class to handle alpha (opacity) values, including validation to ensure the value is within the range 0 to 1.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_AlphaValue
classes.description: A class representing the CSS alpha (opacity) value attribute definition that extends a generic CSS number attribute and enforces value constraints between 0 and 1.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the alpha value attribute definition, indicating that the value is a non-negative number (clamped between 0 and 1).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input alpha value, ensuring it is within the range [0, 1], and returns the corrected value as a string.
